description:
No. 1 Carraig Mhór, Rocklands, Wexford, presents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinctive one-off new-build bungalow residence, forming part of an exclusive bespoke development of just 34 new homes in an established and highly sought-after area of Wexford within walking distance of the Quays and town centre.

Extending to approximately 134 sq. m., this stunning contemporary residence has been thoughtfully designed with modern living in mind and finished to an exceptionally high standard throughout. From the moment you enter, the quality and attention to detail are immediately evident, and will impress from start to finish, with high-end tiling, beautiful flooring and a sophisticated neutral colour palette creating an elegant and timeless interior.

At the heart of the home is a fabulous open-plan kitchen, dining and living space, creating a wonderful environment for both everyday family life and entertaining. The contemporary kitchen forms the focal point of this impressive room, complemented by generous proportions and large windows that allow an abundance of natural light to flood the interior, creating a bright, warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout the day.

The accommodation comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from its own en-suite. Every room has been carefully considered to provide a comfortable and stylish home, with the neutral finishes offering a versatile backdrop for individual tastes and furnishings.

The property also benefits from an impressive A2 energy rating, reflecting the quality of its modern construction and energy-efficient design. Outside, the home enjoys an enclosed private garden with sunny aspect together with a courtyard area to the side and rear, providing excellent outdoor space for relaxing, entertaining and enjoying the surrounding setting. Off-street parking further adds to the convenience and practicality of this exceptional home.

Carraig Mhor enjoys an attractive location close to the many amenities of Wexford Town, while also offering easy access to the beautiful beaches and coastline for which the area is renowned. The property is ideally positioned for access to the N25 and M11, making it particularly convenient for commuting and travel throughout Wexford and the wider southeast.

Ready for immediate occupation, No. 1 Carraig Mhor represents a unique opportunity to secure a brand-new, high-quality bungalow in an exclusive development. With its bespoke design, luxurious finishes, generous accommodation, excellent natural light, A2 energy rating, private garden and courtyard, convenient parking and superb location, this is a home that combines contemporary style, comfort and practicality in equal measure — a truly special residence in which to enjoy modern Wexford.
